chartist-kennington-common-rally.description: An oil-style painting of a large outdoor crowd on an open grassy field under a grey, cloudy sky. Men in top hats, caps and waistcoats press around a wooden cart carrying a huge rolled sheet of paper covered in scribbled handwriting, with several men in dark frock coats standing on or beside it, one gesturing. Red, green and white flags rise above the crowd. Behind them, factory chimneys smoke and a church spire rises over a town skyline.

trafalgar-square-bloody-sunday.description: An oil-style painting of a night street clash in a square. A man in a flat cap and dark coat grips a torn red banner in the foreground, with a crowd of men in bowler hats and caps behind him. Mounted police in dark uniforms with batons and red-coated helmeted mounted soldiers charge through, under gas lamps. A black lion statue and a tall column with a relief sit behind, with a domed building on the right and smoky dark sky.

coxeys-army-march-washington.description: A muddy, rutted road runs toward the viewer. A crowd of men in flat caps, slouch hats and bowler hats, in long coats and work clothes, walks past a white-topped covered wagon pulled by a brown horse. A large American flag on a pole rises at right. A domed white building, resembling the US Capitol, sits in the hazy distance under a stormy sky. No visible text, frame or border.

woman-suffrage-procession-washington.description: A painted street scene: a woman in a dark coat, white dress and wide hat carries a tall banner with purple, gold and white bands, and leads a line of women in white dresses and sashes down a cobbled avenue with tram rails. A domed Capitol-like building stands in the hazy background, with American flags and bunting on the buildings. On the left, a crowd of men in suits and bowler hats presses in, some with raised fists. No visible text.

petrograd-womens-day-protest.description: A large painted crowd of women in headscarves, shawls and dark coats marches down a snowy street along tram tracks, many holding wicker baskets and some raising fists. Handmade placards and black and red banners rise above them. On the right, a line of soldiers in greatcoats and caps stands with rifles. Two old tramcars sit in the background under a grey winter sky.

first-national-hunger-march.description: A column of men in flat caps, scarves and long dark overcoats marches along a muddy, puddled country lane under a grey sky. A drummer boy in the foreground beats a snare drum, and a large plain black banner hangs on two poles above the marchers. Bare trees and hedges line the road, and the figures recede into mist.

sacco-vanzetti-worldwide-protests.description: A painted street protest at dusk. A man in a flat cap shouts with a raised fist, holding a blank placard. Behind him a crowd of men in caps and hats and women in cloche hats carry blank placards and banners on poles. On the right a line of uniformed police with batons stands before a large neoclassical stone building with columns and arched windows. Oil-painting style, full-bleed, no visible text or frame.

bonus-army-march-washington.description: An older man in a campaign-style hat and olive field jacket with a medal on his chest leans on a cane and looks to the left. Two or three men in caps and coats stand at the left and right edges. Behind them a sprawling camp of shacks and tents sits on a flat by a river, with smoke rising and a small fire burning. A white domed building with classical wings sits across the water under a dark, stormy sky. No visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

jarrow-march.description: A long column of men in flat caps and dark overcoats walks along a muddy, puddled track under a stormy grey sky. Two men in front play harmonicas, and a tall man at the right carries a blank brown banner on a pole. A lattice crane stands on the horizon behind them, with more marchers receding into the distance.

rosenstrasse-protest-berlin.description: A group of women in dark winter coats and headscarves stands close together on a snowy cobbled street, looking up toward a grey stone building with barred windows and a dark arched doorway. Several figures in steel helmets and long dark coats stand in the background at right. The painting is in a dark, painterly style and fills the frame edge to edge. No text, letters or numbers are visible.

bengali-language-movement-protests.description: A painted street scene: three figures in front, a young man in a white shirt on the left, a woman in a white sari in the centre and a young man in a white shirt on the right, walking arm in arm. A black cloth banner on two poles rises above them. Behind them a crowd of young men in light shirts, and a few helmeted figures far back. Colonial-style multi-storey buildings with arched balconies line a sunlit street. No visible text, no frame.

first-aldermaston-march.description: A painted scene in heavy rain. A hooded young man in a black duffel coat walks toward the viewer, carrying an acoustic guitar and holding a round peace-symbol sign. Behind him, a long column of men in trench coats, flat caps and dark suits carries similar peace signs, and some hold umbrellas. The muddy, puddled path runs between bare trees under a dark, stormy sky. No visible text, frame or border.

anpo-protests-japan.description: A painted night scene of a dense crowd of men in white shirts and black trousers, many with white headbands, linking arms and marching toward a large stone building with a stepped roof and columns. Black banners on tall poles rise over the crowd, with lit lamps and street lights, and uniformed police officers stand at the edges. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

greenham-common-womens-march.description: A line of women in dark padded coats and knit hats walks along a muddy path beside a tall chain-link fence topped with barbed wire. The lead woman carries a large patched flag with a peace symbol and a women's symbol. A small child in a knit hat holds the hand of a woman pushing a pram. Scarves are tied to the fence. Behind the fence are a flat field, a distant watchtower and grey buildings under an overcast sky. No visible text, frame or border.

battle-of-seattle-wto-protests.description: A painted scene of a large, pale, translucent elderly woman with long grey hair reaching out one arm above a crowd. Protesters with signs and several people in green sea turtle costumes fill the left and centre, while black-helmeted riot police with shields and batons stand on the right in drifting smoke. Modern glass skyscrapers rise behind, and the signs show no legible text.

global-anti-iraq-war-protests.description: A dense crowd of people fills a wide European-style city street lined with tall stone classical buildings with many windows and a domed tower in the distance under an overcast sky. Many people hold rainbow-striped flags, some with purple and blue bands, and a few hold up blank hand-made placards with dark silhouette images. The painting is in an oil-painted style, with people mostly seen from behind in modern jackets and coats. No readable text is visible, and the image runs edge to edge with no frame.

occupy-wall-street.description: A night scene in a city plaza among bare trees, packed with dome tents and tarps. People sit around a small fire in the centre. Cardboard signs lean against the trees with illegible scrawled marks. Lit glass skyscrapers and a construction crane rise behind. Modern dress and gear. No frame, no blood.

hong-kong-umbrella-movement.description: A crowd of protesters holds yellow and black umbrellas on a wide city road. Tents line a central barrier, with boxes and debris piled among them. Tall glass high-rise towers rise on both sides under a dusky sky. White banners hang from an overpass, and a man in goggles and a face mask in the foreground raises a yellow umbrella. No visible text.

womens-march-2017.description: A dense outdoor crowd, mostly women in pink knitted hats with cat ears, fills a broad street in overcast light. In the foreground a raised hand holds up a blank tan cardboard sign, and many more blank signs are held above the crowd. A domed building, resembling a capitol, sits in the hazy background between bare trees. Painterly, oil-like style, no readable text.

woman-life-freedom-protests.description: A woman with long wavy brown hair stands at the centre front, holding a pair of scissors in one hand and a cut lock of dark hair raised high in the other. Around her, women in headscarves and men raise fists and hair locks on a city street at dusk, with bare trees, apartment blocks, smoke and orange fire glow in the background. It is an oil-painting style image with no visible text, no frame, and no blood or injury.
